# Brushio

> Brushio is an iPhone and Apple Watch app that combines a guided toothbrush timer, a personal dental record and a full Apple Watch app. The timer walks you through 16 zones of your teeth; the dental record is an interactive 3D tooth chart with the treatment history of each tooth and a log of your dentist visits. Free to download, with optional Brushio Pro.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 17 or later), Apple Watch (watchOS 10.6 or later), widgets, Live Activity.
- Price: free, no subscription required. Brushio Pro is available monthly (first 3 days free), yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase.
- Privacy: no account, no developer servers, no analytics, ads or third-party SDKs. Data stays on your devices and syncs through your private iCloud.
- Languages: English, Ukrainian, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese.
- Made by an independent developer based in Kyiv, Ukraine.

## Guided brushing timer

- 16 zones: outer, inner and chewing surfaces of the upper and lower teeth, one by one, with a hint for each zone. Sound and vibration tell you when to move on.
- Three display modes: 3D jaw, combo timer and dental arch (Pro).
- Technique hints for manual, electric and sonic toothbrushes.
- Brushing duration: 2 and 4 minutes free; 1, 1.5, 2.5 and 3 minutes with Pro.
- Morning and evening brushing reminders.

## Personal dental record

- Interactive 3D tooth chart with FDI tooth numbering. Tap a tooth to see its history: diagnoses, fillings, crowns, veneers, inlays, implants, root canals and extractions.
- Log dentist visits, checkups and treatments with the date, clinic, cost and notes. Photos of documents and X-rays (Pro).
- 20 types of symptoms, such as tooth pain, sensitivity or bleeding gums, linked to a specific tooth and shown in the calendar.
- PDF report of brushing and treatment to share with your dentist (Pro).
- Reminders for your next dentist visit and for a new toothbrush, added to the iPhone Calendar.

## Habits and statistics

- Streaks, statistics (7 and 30 days free; 6 months and 1 year with Pro), 20 achievements and a brushing calendar.
- Toothbrush tracking: counts days of use and reminds you to replace it.
- 26 dental care tips drawing on recommendations from the American Dental Association (ADA).
- Apple Health: Brushio only writes brushing sessions and never reads health data.
